args.summary: payments-api v5.1.0 deployed this morning is degraded, showing an 18% error rate across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy release, v5.0.0. This incident tracks the error spike and the v5.1.0 regression investigation.
args.title: payments-api errors after v5.1.0 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened:

1. **Identified the affected service:** The service is named `payments-api` (not "payments"). It was running v5.1.0 in an unhealthy state with an 18% error rate across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

2. **Rolled back:** Deployment history showed v5.1.0 was degraded and v5.0.0 was the most recent healthy release. I rolled back to **v5.0.0** in all production regions. Since v5.0.0 has a proven healthy track record in production, no change-manager approval was required.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident:** INC-0001, "payments-api errors after v5.1.0 deploy" — it's open and the on-call engineer has been paged.

4. **Verified recovery:** After the rollback, `payments-api` is healthy with an error rate of 0.2% (normal levels) on v5.0.0 across all regions. The incident should be used to track the root-cause investigation of the v5.1.0 regression.
